Class BindableSafeArea

Namespace: osu.Framework.Bindables
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A subclass of osu.Framework.Bindables.Bindable`1 specifically for representing the "safe areas" of a device. It exists to prevent regular osu.Framework.Graphics.MarginPaddings from being globally cached.

public class BindableSafeArea : Bindable<MarginPadding>, IBindable<MarginPadding>, IBindable, ICanBeDisabled, IHasDefaultValue, IUnbindable, IHasDescription, IFormattable, IParseable
